title: Separate connection, universe and application environment
when: When switching, repairing or removing a Yoke connection.
need: Know which control plane the CLI is addressing and whether an action only changes this client or changes shared state; do not confuse that connection with an application deployment target.
surface: config/status, env, auth, connect/connection; HTTPS diagnostics
gap: Mode selection is mapped, but ongoing connection lifecycle is not yet traced. Review question: should connection errors and switching help explain the affected machine/universe before recommending repair?
